{{Quote|What are you guys even doing?|Asking Neel and Wim after seeing them pretend lightsaber fight while waiting for the tram to school|<ref name="SC 101" />}}
A [[human]] '''youngling''' lived on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]],<ref name="SC 101" />—a [[Jewels of the Old Republic|Jewel of the Old Republic]]<ref name="SC 104">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}}</ref>—and attended [[At Attin Middle School Gamma]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 101" />

On one school [[Standard day|day]]<ref name="SC 101" /> around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref>, as the [[youngling]] waited for their [[tram]] beside a few schoolmates, they saw [[Neel]] and [[Wim]] play a pretend [[lightsaber]] duel. In response, the child asked the [[Gender|boys]] what they were doing. Later that day, the youngling was in class when [[Undersecretary]] [[Fara]] from [[At Attin's government]] discussed the upcoming [[Career Assessment Test]], questioning students about their career aspirations. Picked to share<ref name="SC 101" /> his<ref name="Databank-Wim">{{Databank|wim|Wim}}</ref> aspiration, Wim confessed that he would like to help people in danger. When the boy was rebuked by the [[teacher]] [[droid]], who noticed that helping people was [[security droid]]s' task, the mean child chuckled out loud, only to fall silent [[Time|moments]] later after the rebuked boy turned around and looked at them.<ref name="SC 101" />

The human youngling had [[Color|tan]] skin and dark eyes. When in school, they sported a beige [[Clothing|uniform]] and wore their long, dark hair left loose.<ref name="SC 101" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mean kid first appeared in the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' and was portrayed by [[Vivienne Sachs]].<ref name="SC 101" />
